SELECT principals.id 
FROM principals 
WHERE principals.token_hash = ?

SELECT internal_instances.project_id, internal_instances.principal_id 
FROM internal_instances 
WHERE internal_instances.id = ?

SELECT projects.id, projects.owner_id, projects.runtime_id, projects.name 
FROM projects 
WHERE projects.id = ? AND projects.owner_id = ?

SELECT internal_app_runs.id 
FROM internal_app_runs JOIN internal_run_bindings ON internal_run_bindings.app_run_id = internal_app_runs.id 
WHERE internal_run_bindings.run_id = ? AND internal_app_runs.instance_id = ? AND internal_app_runs.principal_id = ?

SELECT internal_app_runs.id, internal_app_runs.release_id 
FROM internal_app_runs JOIN internal_run_bindings ON internal_run_bindings.app_run_id = internal_app_runs.id 
WHERE internal_run_bindings.run_id = ? AND internal_app_runs.instance_id = ? AND internal_app_runs.principal_id = ?

SELECT runs.project_id, runs.runtime_id, runs.principal_id 
FROM runs 
WHERE runs.id = ?

SELECT internal_instances.runtime_id 
FROM internal_instances 
WHERE internal_instances.id = ?

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(events.data, ?) AS iid, JSON_EXTRACT(events.data, ?) AS aid, JSON_EXTRACT(events.data, ?) AS rel 
FROM events 
WHERE events.run_id = ? AND events.kind = ? AND JSON_EXTRACT(events.data, ?) = ?

SELECT csv_owner_records.id, csv_owner_records.run_id, csv_owner_records.principal_id, csv_owner_records.project_id, csv_owner_records.instance_id, csv_owner_records.sequence, csv_owner_records.request_key, csv_owner_records.request_fingerprint, csv_owner_records.kind, csv_owner_records.status, csv_owner_records.previous_fingerprint, csv_owner_records.created_at, csv_owner_records.fingerprint 
FROM csv_owner_records 
WHERE csv_owner_records.run_id = ? ORDER BY csv_owner_records.sequence

SELECT csv_owner_seals.record_id, csv_owner_seals.run_id, csv_owner_seals.metadata_fingerprint, csv_owner_seals.payload_fingerprint 
FROM csv_owner_seals 
WHERE csv_owner_seals.run_id = ?
